screening.samplingFinding: All sixty unseen query pages on twenty qualified selection domains completed under isolated headed Chromium process bounds with zero parent hard timeouts. Frozen minimum-root, query-relevance, screenshot-evidence, obstruction, and original-resolution visual checks accepted forty-two pages and rejected eighteen, a 70% strict yield.
screening.visualValidationFinding: All fifty-six machine-qualified full-page annotation screenshots and every accepted frozen root were inspected at original resolution. Four pages were machine-rejected for fewer than eight candidate roots. Fourteen more were visually rejected because the selected products were unrelated to the query, the result set was dominated by adjacent products or general assortments, or a fixed consent or discount surface covered selected evidence. The forty-two accepted pages preserve coherent title, price, quantity, and native unit-price evidence or legitimate abstention cases across area, mass, count, volume, and length.
